verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair capability to ask of a monitoring SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented Sentry sandbox, test organization, or dry-run mode that isolates testing from production data. A community report of a user running their own Sentry in Docker for local debugging is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
